Package com.codedstream.otterstream.kafka

package com.codedstream.otterstream.kafka
  • Classes
    Class
    Description
    DecisionKafkaSerializationSchema
    Serializes rule-engine Decisions to JSON for a Flink KafkaSink — the natural pairing with InferenceResultKafkaSerializationSchema: publish the raw inference result to one topic and the post-rule-engine decision to another (or the same topic, differently keyed), so downstream consumers (case management, alerting, audit log) don't need to embed rule logic themselves.
    InferenceResultKafkaSerializationSchema
    Serializes InferenceResult to JSON for a Flink KafkaSink.
    OtterKafkaSinks
    One-liner builders for publishing InferenceResults or Decisions to Kafka, on top of Flink's own KafkaSink — not a replacement for it.
